memories.name: Souvenir Spoon
memories.blurb: A spoon from the gas station buffet, stamped MISSOURI. It bends if you look at it too hard.

memories.name: Highway Postcard
memories.blurb: The card shows a tornado. The tornado is holding a chicken. Nobody at the gas station would admit to printing it.

memories.name: Grandma's Snack Bag
memories.blurb: Mom packed it at 5 a.m. It contains eleven cookies and one (1) extremely hopeful napkin.

memories.name: Shuffleboard Puck
memories.blurb: Won from a bear. Technically the bear won. The bear says it was a tie.

memories.name: Carved Bear Keychain
memories.blurb: Bought from a vending machine that only accepted quarters and compliments.

memories.name: Cabin Postcard
memories.blurb: The cabin on the card has four floors. The cabin we stayed in has three. Dad calls this 'marketing'.

memories.name: Tiny Mayor's Button
memories.blurb: It says VOTE BARKINGTON. It is the size of a thumbtack and weighs as much as a promise.

memories.name: Wind Cave Crystal
memories.blurb: A crystal from a passage with no name, given to Jira by a prairie dog engineer with a very small hard hat.

memories.name: Ferret King's Crown
memories.blurb: Cardboard. Glitter. A sticker on the inside that says PROPERTY OF THE KINGDOM, DO NOT WEAR SIDEWAYS.

memories.name: Giant Sheep's Bell
memories.blurb: The sheep rang it every time Joel said 'look'. That was a lot of ringing.

memories.name: Pumpkin Lantern
memories.blurb: It was a living pumpkin. It is now a lantern. It seems fine about the whole thing.

memories.name: Storybook Ticket
memories.blurb: Admits one family. Expires never. Smells faintly of someone else's popcorn.

memories.name: Union Station Ticket
memories.blurb: Kansas City to Anywhere, one way. The conductor punched a shape that does not exist on trains.

memories.name: Rabbit Hole Key
memories.blurb: Opens a door that is only there when you are not looking directly at it.

memories.name: Science City Badge
memories.blurb: JOEL, JUNIOR SCIENTIST. Handwritten. Laminated by a machine that was also an experiment.

memories.name: Prism Keychain
memories.blurb: Hold it up and the whole room splits into colors that were not in the room a second ago.

memories.name: Fog Room Photo
memories.blurb: Four silhouettes in fog. Dad's hair is doing something the fog cannot explain.

memories.name: Glow Bracelet
memories.blurb: It glows for exactly as long as you believe it will. Joel still believes. Joel is why it works.

memories.name: The Family Photo
memories.blurb: All four of them, plus a small shadow in the corner, at the top of the Pavilion steps.

memories.name: Jira's Notebook
memories.blurb: Every clue, every vacation, every strange little thing. Page one says: 'Somebody is taking our trips.'

memories.name: Joel's Pocket Rock
memories.blurb: It is a rock. It has been to seven states. It has a name. The name is Rock.

clues.name: Postcard From Nowhere
clues.text: A postcard with no picture, no stamp, and no return address. On the back, in tiny careful letters: 'Keep this one. Please.'

clues.name: A Receipt For One Memory
clues.text: A buffet receipt. Item: ONE (1) AFTERNOON, SLIGHTLY USED. Total: $0.00. Paid with: a photograph of a family that is not yours.

clues.name: Tornado Tag
clues.text: A luggage tag blown off some other family's suitcase. The address has been scratched out and rewritten so many times the paper has gone soft.

clues.name: Whittled Warning
clues.text: Somebody carved a message into the porch rail: 'THE WOODS REMEMBER YOUR TRIP. DO YOU?' Underneath, much smaller: 'sorry, that was meant to be friendly.'

clues.name: Bird Call Chart
clues.text: A laminated chart of local bird calls. One entry is circled: 'NOT A BIRD (probably a collector)'. The drawing is a little box with eyes.

clues.name: A Bear's Grocery List
clues.text: HONEY. BERRIES. ONE (1) FAMILY VACATION, UNOPENED. The last item has three question marks after it, like the bear was not sure it was allowed.

clues.name: Espionage Pamphlet
clues.text: A tiny pamphlet titled 'HOW TO SPOT A SPY'. Every page is blank except the last, which says 'they look like a family on vacation'.

clues.name: The Prairie Dog Times
clues.text: Front page: FAMILY SPOTTED. THEY HAVE A COOLER. ARE THEY STEALING OUR SUMMER? The crossword answers are all 'unclear'.

clues.name: Cave Survey, Amended
clues.text: A Wind Cave survey map with one tunnel drawn in red pencil and labeled 'NOT A TUNNEL. DO NOT GO. IT IS A DRAWER.'

clues.name: Clockmaker's Note
clues.text: 'The clock does not keep time. It keeps afternoons. Wind it kindly.' Signed with a squiggle that could be a name or a small box with eyes.

clues.name: A Torn Page
clues.text: A page from a scrapbook that is definitely yours. It shows tonight. It was printed before tonight. The glue is still wet.

clues.name: Giant's Shopping List
clues.text: BREAD. MILK. ONE SMALL FAMILY TO REMEMBER HIM BY. The giant has written 'no rush' beside the last one, which is somehow worse.

clues.name: Blueprint, Unsigned
clues.text: A blueprint for a machine labeled MEMORY ENGINE. One component is drawn as a photo album. Another is drawn as a child's hand, holding the first one.

clues.name: Fairy Tale Patent
clues.text: Patent #7 for 'a device that makes a story remember itself'. The examiner's note: 'emotionally sound, structurally unclear'.

clues.name: A Note, Neatly Filed
clues.text: A card in a filing drawer labeled FAMILIES WHO ALMOST FORGOT. Your family name is there. There is a small checkmark. There is also a small eraser mark.

clues.name: Light Mixing Chart
clues.text: A chart of colors and the feelings they belong to. RED: the argument in the car. BLUE: the quiet after. YELLOW: Joel, laughing at nothing.

clues.name: A Lantern With No Bulb
clues.text: An empty lantern, still warm. On the bottom: 'This one held the drive home. It was my favorite.'

clues.name: A Very Bright Apology
clues.text: Written in light on the wall, fading: 'I did not mean to make it strange. I only wanted to be in the picture.'

clues.name: The Collector's Ledger
clues.text: Every vacation your family ever took, dated and filed. In the margin beside each one, the same three words: 'they came back'.

clues.name: Itinerary, Faded
clues.text: An itinerary in Mom's handwriting for a trip that never happened. Seven days, six stops, four names. At the bottom: 'maybe next year'.

clues.name: A Photo With No Faces
clues.text: A family photo where everyone is a soft blur, like the camera was crying. On the back: 'I kept it anyway. It was still a Tuesday with them.'

secrets.name: The Golden Receipt
secrets.blurb: A receipt for 'one perfect afternoon, no refunds'. The Keeper kept it in a napkin dispenser.

secrets.name: Golden Thimble
secrets.blurb: Tiny, brass, and warm. Someone has been mending the same photograph for years.

secrets.name: Golden Acorn
secrets.blurb: A tiny nation's highest honor, awarded to Joel for 'being approximately the right size'.

secrets.name: Golden Bookmark
secrets.blurb: It marks the page of a story that has no ending yet. The next page is blank and waiting.

secrets.name: Golden Ticket
secrets.blurb: Admit one to a vacation that has not happened. It is dated next summer. It is already slightly creased from being carried.

secrets.name: Golden Prism
secrets.blurb: Hold it to the light and you can see a family that is yours, in a room you have not been in yet.

secrets.name: Golden Photo
secrets.blurb: The only picture the Collector ever took of itself. It is standing just outside the frame, hoping to be asked in.

lore.title: The Scrapbook
lore.text: A scrapbook with seven stiff pages. Somebody has already written the dates on them in pencil.

lore.title: The Small Box
lore.text: Every level has a drawer, and every drawer has a box, and every box has one photograph in it. None of the photographs have people in them.

lore.title: What It Eats
lore.text: The Collector does not eat memories. It borrows them, holds them up to the light, and puts them back slightly warmer.

lore.title: Why The Vacations Change
lore.text: A remembered vacation gets bigger every year. The Collector just helps. A gas station becomes a fortress. A cabin becomes a kingdom.

lore.title: The Invitation
lore.text: At the very back of the scrapbook there is a blank page with a cupholder-sized circle drawn on it, and the words 'reserved' in tiny careful letters.
